red_notes: The initial camera run includes an invalid DestroyImmediate-in-render-callback test, excluded from production defect claims. The valid failure count was four.
Initial depth fixture attempts had a specular-only black Lit control; corrected to metallic workflow with visible diffuse witness before the retained red run.
Legacy helper test reproduces a generated-source call-contract regression introduced by the scalar change; the vector overload preserves old output.
coverage_notes: Full graphics suite contained 1003 cases; the follow-up runs add one distinct owner-destruction test, rechecking all 8 camera cases.
128 seeded GetRimValue inputs are checked within one test. Test count is not input-domain coverage.
D3D12 runs contain 53 cases, including the original 7 camera cases; owner destruction was added afterward and checked on D3D11.
Historical original-image evidence is retained, not recaptured or modified.
No new SDK/AAO build, VRC upload, package deployment or physical XR acceptance in this follow-up.

gpu.scope: Four Uber shaders, depth keyword off/on, overlap/reflected view, clipped UI Lit with eight lights. Does not measure Distortion GrabPass or compositor callback CPU.
